fr.elements: Main Residence; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Walkway; Landscaped Area; Open Green Space; Access Drive
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Dense Vegetation; Limited Turnaround Space
fr.recommendations:
• Trim vegetation along the access drive to maintain clear passage for emergency vehicles on both sides.
• Cut back dense vegetation near access points so responders can quickly identify and reach entry locations.
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the road in both directions.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles so emergency vehicles can reach the residence without obstruction.
• Designate and mark a flat, open area near the residence where emergency vehicles can turn around.
• Remove or reposition landscaping features that narrow the access drive or restrict vehicle movement.
• Mark all access points clearly so responding crews can quickly identify the fastest route to the residence.
• Keep walkways clear of debris and obstructions so responders can move around the structure on foot.
• Post the property address visibly at the road entrance so responding units can confirm the correct access drive.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Trees; Tree Cluster; Scattered Shrubs; Open Terrain; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Grass Cover; Multiple Access Routes
wildfire.recommendations:
• Mow or cut grass around structures before it dries out seasonally.
• Thin trees within the visible cluster nearest to structures to create gaps between the canopies.
• Trim lower branches on scattered trees close to structures to reduce the path fire could take from the ground into the trees.
• Remove shrubs that sit directly against or within a few feet of any structure.
• Keep gaps between individual shrubs so fire cannot spread easily from one to the next near buildings.
• Cut back any shrubs or low branches that hang over or touch rooflines or exterior walls.
• Keep all access routes clear of overhanging branches and overgrown vegetation along the edges.
• Mow or cut grass along driveway edges to maintain clear passage for vehicles.
